name: Workspace Manager Dialog
description: Edits Workspace identity, default launch Folder, and its stable resource namespace through the shared Workbench resource-form structure.

states: Open Manage Workspace from a Workspace ellipsis or context menu and inspect name and primary Folder fields.
Change the primary Folder and confirm that the modal keeps the established cancel and save behavior.
Open Manage Workspace for a one-Folder Workspace and confirm that no redundant primary designation or Set Primary action appears.
Open a multi-Folder Workspace, hover or focus a non-primary Folder, and inspect the raised Set Primary action and full-path Tooltip.
Choose Add Folder in browser composition and confirm that only the final list row becomes a path field with compact Cancel and Add icon actions whose Tooltips show their keyboard hints.
Open Manage Workspace, choose Add Folder, and confirm that native acquisition commits the selected Folder without replacing the final row with a manual path field.
With SSH attachment available, choose Add Folder and inspect the explicit Local and SSH actions without closing the Workspace manager.
Inspect the appended native Folder and published SSH-marked remote Folder while the Workspace-name draft, primary Folder, existing Workspace defaults, and outer Dialog actions remain stable.

useWhen: A person renames a Workspace or changes its default launch Folder.
A person inspects, adds, or removes Folders in the Workspace launch-resource namespace.
avoidWhen: The requested change only renames or dissolves an optional Project group.
The operation creates, duplicates, or closes a Workspace without editable resource fields.
invariants: The selected primary Folder belongs to the stable resource namespace retained by the Workspace after a move or Project dissolution.
Removing the selected Folder falls back to the next available Folder without prompting for a replacement.
Cancel commits neither the Workspace name draft nor the primary Folder draft; resource edits commit independently.
A one-Folder namespace omits redundant primary-folder controls.
Only non-primary resource rows reveal Set Primary on hover or keyboard focus using a raised action surface.
Hovering or focusing a Folder name exposes its full path through the shared Tooltip.
Browser Folder entry replaces only the final Add Folder row while the surrounding list and outer Dialog actions stay stable.
Adding a Folder validates empty and exact duplicate paths before invoking the semantic action.
Native acquisition admits one request and rechecks the same resource namespace and duplicate paths before commit; regrouping does not invalidate it.
Cancellation, bounded acquisition failure, disposal, and retired requests do not change Folder membership.
SSH attachment receives the exact resource scope identity; remote Folders have a localized visible and accessible SSH marker.
